name: The AI Aerodynamicist (race-car CFD lab)
description: The autonomous lab on a parametric race car: lower drag at 70 m/s keeping downforce and balance, OpenFOAM as the reference, surrogates on held-out runs, the next CFD chosen by what is unknown (examples/autolab_aero/autolab_aero.py). Full: the OpenFOAM campaign (20 runs, hours); quick: the dashboard of the recorded session.

params.tolerance_source: OpenFOAM steady RANS on the same meshes: 1e-6 relative (differences reported as measured)
